local selected = "primary"
if string.find(prefix, "route=canary;", 1, true) then selected = "canary" end
ngx.var.selected_upstream = selected
ngx.req.set_header("x-selected", selected)

fixtures.origin.lua:
ngx.req.read_body()
local body = assert(ngx.req.get_body_data())
if ngx.req.get_headers()["x-bench-verify"] == "1" then
    ngx.header["x-body-md5"] = ngx.md5(body)
    ngx.header["x-body-length"] = #body
end
ngx.header["content-length"] = 1024
ngx.print(string.rep("x", 1024))
fixtures.wrk-body.lua:
local requests = {}
local counter = 0
requests[1] = wrk.format("POST", "/route-body", {["Host"]="localhost", ["Content-Type"]="application/octet-stream"}, "route=canary;" .. string.rep("x", 65523))
requests[2] = wrk.format("POST", "/route-body", {["Host"]="localhost", ["Content-Type"]="application/octet-stream"}, string.rep("x", 1024) .. "route=canary;" .. string.rep("x", 64499))
function request()
  counter = counter % 2 + 1
  return requests[counter]
end

function done(summary, latency, requests)
  local e = summary.errors

    summary.requests, summary.duration / 1000000, summary.bytes,
    e.connect, e.read, e.write, e.status, e.timeout,
    latency:percentile(50) / 1000, latency:percentile(95) / 1000, latency:percentile(99) / 1000))
end
